items.rationale: Policy 5.2.6(b) covers costs of inspecting and assessing the damage to determine cause and extent, up to EUR 3,000 per event. Reference Case 2 (diagnostic inspection, t between 60 and 84) and Case 12 (assessment included in a larger line, but similar scope). This is a standard, single assessment call.

items.description: Indoor leak detection incl. measurement technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Policy 5.2.6(a) covers leak location (acoustic, thermographic, etc.) and technician time, up to EUR 1,000 per event. Reference Case 2 (diagnostic inspection, t between 60 and 84) and Case 16 (thermal imaging, t below 57, possibly 0). This is a standard, single leak detection with technician and vehicle.

items.description: Floor covering removal incl. linoleum and skirting, surface preparation and construction-waste disposal
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.5/7.1.7(a) covers dismantling and disposal of affected finishes, but 7.1.10 excludes moisture damage repairs for gradual leaks (material ageing): only the pipe repair and diagnostic costs are covered, not drying or floor removal. Reference Case 2 and policy: t = 0.
Policy 7.1.8(b): Outlay for contractor's own business operation (provisioning for personnel) is not indemnified.

items.description: Technical drying (large-area, cavity and borehole) incl. labour, dust protection and kitchen disinfection
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.10: For gradual leaks from material ageing, only pipe repair and diagnostic costs are covered, not drying or disinfection of building. Reference Case 2 and policy: t = 0.
Policy 7.1.7(b): Utility charges for drying are not indemnified if invoiced separately, and 7.1.10 excludes drying for gradual leaks. Reference Case 2 and policy: t = 0.
